summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of a new CFO, Anuj Goel, effective August 24, 2026, under an employment agreement with a subsidiary. The filing details compensation (AUD$650,000 salary, incentive awards, and a sign-on RSU grant) but does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign. This is a routine executive appointment filing, not a forced or abrupt management change constituting an event itself.
